Results.ReviewText: I love my little Weber grill. I use it all the time.
Results.Title: I use my Weber grill for breakfast lunch & dinner

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for sharing your feedback and for choosing another Weber Q1200. We are glad to hear that its compact size and portability continue to make it a good fit for your family. We are sorry, though, that you've had to replace several parts over time. We appreciate you taking the time to share these concerns, as feedback like yours helps us understand where we can improve the ownership experience. We hope your new Q1200 provides you with many enjoyable meals for years to come!

Results.ReviewText: This grill is great for small spaces and portable. It's our second one. We had to replace several parts over time so we decided to buy a new one. It is necessary to keep it clean and it is very difficult to reach around the burner without taking it out. Despite the inconveniences, it is just the right size for our small family.
Results.Title: Compact and convenient

Results.ReviewText: This is a great alternative to a big bulky barbecue. It’s small but big enough to grill a couple of steaks. We are enjoying the ease of using it. And the plates are removable so easy to wash in the kitchen sink.
Results.Title: Love our new bbq

Results.ReviewText: This grill is the perfect size for my compact space. I love the green color. Oh, and it heats up quickly and cooks food well, too
Results.Title: Perfect little grill

Results.ReviewText:
I have had larger Weber grills in the past, but I gave them up in favor of the Weber Q1200 which fits my widowed lifestyle perfectly.  It accommodates four steaks with ease, is easily moved in and out of my garage on the stand which I purchased years ago, and heats up to 500 degrees in only 10 minutes.  Furthermore, it is easy to clean.
My current grill is the third one that I have owned in 21 years, and, since I do not want to dirty my kitchen oven or stove top unnecessarily, I grill at least 4 nights of the week!  
Additionally, I have "sold" this grill to four different households when they have witnessed its excellent culinary output as my dinner guests!
Results.Title: Small is Only a Perception

Results.ReviewText:
I love my little Weber Grill. Perfect for my husband and me.
Cooks perfectly.
Only problem we are having is we couldn't get one of those small Coleman cylinders attached, so have to bring the big tank when we go to the camp.
Results.Title: Weber Q1200 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. It meets all my needs when camping. I highly recommend this grill.
Results.Title: Excellent grill!

Results.ReviewText: Tried and true. Have just replaced similar unit I’ve had for ten years. Great product especially for condo balconies without a lot of room.
Results.Title: Tried and true.

Results.ReviewText: I love my Weber Q. I recently replaced my 12 year old Weber Q because I cannot do without it. This little grill heats up quickly, is fuel efficient, and cooks my food evenly. I keep this grill outside of my kitchen and use it several times a week.
Results.Title: Love my kitchen tool!

Results.ReviewText: Compact, easy to use, carry and clean but quality enough to grill a great meal
Results.Title: Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Part worked great,  we’re back to grilling again.  Weber came through for us ands sent us the part we needed in a timely manor.
Results.Title: Problem solved, thank you

Results.ReviewText: Great portable grill that's just right for my wife and I.
Results.Title: Great Little Grill

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill first one I have for 20 years and finally gave up the only problem. I have with this one is even though I seasoned the grates. The meat still sticks to it. Seems to be a Weber problem on the newer grill i also have a Genesis that's about 9 years old. And it has the same problem. I wish you'd go back to the old grates. You were using those worked wonderful
Results.Title: Love it but

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We’re sorry to hear that the grill is not heating up as it should. Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we want to make this right for you. Please look for an outreach email from our Care Team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Won't get higher than 400 degrees.  Spoke to Weber and the instructions they gave didn't work. I contacted Amazon for a refund.  They changed the manufacturing of this item -- 2 others were great that I'd had for 20 years combined.
Results.Title: Only Weber that's completely failed.

Results.ReviewText: Exactly as you would expect from Weber.  Perfect little camp grill for us with plenty of size to handle two families worth of food.
Results.Title: Another Win From Weber

Results.ReviewText: I really love this little grill. I have it as my only grill. It is good enought for several burgers , many hot dogs , and a good amount of vegetables.  I daily cook for about 3 to 4 and it is sufficiant for that. Adding a nice healthy fresh salad or couple sides keeps my kitchen easy to clean and makes dinner healthy and quick.  It is a great addition my love of cooking.    Plus it is easy to clean.   I have an old bucket filled with water and soap set aside just for this grill so when its all cooled I toss my grill plates in and a few minutes later they are washable and cleaned up.  so not too much work there.   Hope this imspires others to do portable grills.  I did my research and Weber often was the portable of choice.  I think so too now.
Results.Title: great little grill

Results.ReviewText: I love the Q1200.  Compact, very hot, easy to clean
Results.Title: I love this Grill

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for taking the time to share your honest feedback. We understand how frustrating and disappointing it must have been to have the leg on your Q1200 grill break, causing your food to fall to the ground. We truly appreciate you bringing this to our attention, and your comments will be shared with our team for review and consideration. 

We do see that a replacement set of legs was sent to you as a courtesy. If you need any additional assistance or have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us directly. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Q1200 leg broke, food tumbled to the ground.  Weber replaced plastic leg, but took an hour of tedious disassembly/reassembled.  Clearly poorly designed leg that broke right at the drip pan slot.  Wished I never bought this grill.
Results.Title: Cheap Plastic Legs Broke

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We apologize for the disappointment! That's not the experience we expect from our products.

We see a member of our team is assisting you, and we will ensure your issue is resolved ASAP. Thank you for your patience and for choosing a Weber grill.
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Very disappointed. How could I go wrong with a Weber grill, so I thought. We received the grill more than a month ago and still cannot use it. I was sent a couple of regulators as this is what they said was faulty, still not the answer. They are now sending a new burner which  is on order and they don't know when I will receive it. I purchased this product for specific summer cookout dates and have not been able to use it. No one will offer a resolution. they will not refund me nor will they send a replacement grill. This is beyond frustrating and ridiculous. I am not one to provide reviews but could not resist when Weber asked that I review the product they know is unsatisfactory. I wish this to be resolved and before I know it the summer grilling season will be over and still not working grill?
Results.Title: Complete disappointment

Results.ReviewText: Well built and gets the job done. Light and small enough to allow luggage to fit in trunk easily
Results.Title: Perfect for traveling

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, it’s perfect and compact n great for everything.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Love the Q1200 grill. Its small and easy to clean. The grill cover is very nice and protects the grill from the weather and animals.
Results.Title: Blue grill

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. The Coleman 1lb Disposable Cylinder is one of the standard LP cylinders used for our portable grills. Once you take the cap off the disposable cylinder, you will see a hole in the middle that will connect to the grill’s regulator. You can find more information on how to connect the LP cylinders to the grill in the grill owner’s manual. 
We hope this information helps. Please don’t hesitate to reach out to us directly if you need assistance. We are always here to help. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: So annoyed - bought this tabletop grill and it wont accommodate a standard coleman 1lb propane tank which is sold everywhere - now we have to hunt down a canister that would work- you would think weber for the cost of this grill would offer tanks that fit - and no i dont want to store a big tank and buy a connector hose!
Results.Title: Super Annoying

Results.ReviewText: Love the concept of this grill. Got it to use outside our camper. It takes a little getting used to. Takes a little while to get up to a decent heat. If you use a griddle on the grates it won't go much over 300 degrees but will def cook an egg at that temp. - If I was going to buy a grill for a gift, I don't think I would pay the price for this one but now that we have it, I will learn to enjoy it.
Results.Title: Weber Q1200 propane grill

Results.ReviewText: A great little camping grill.  Compact and versatile.
Results.Title: Meets all your camping needs.

Results.ReviewText:
had previous model 6 years, gas pipe finally eroded and just bought new one.  Grill grates much better, easy to clean.  Plastic scraper for body easily found in paint or dry wall area in store.
cannot brown buns unless you stand right there and remove after 30 seconds as this one is very hot and they burn quickly.  Heats up faster than instructions indicate so be ready to go when you light up as it will be 7-9 minutes to 500 degrees on the start-up setting.  Loved the old one. this one is better. would recommend to anyone
Results.Title: Superb Small Grill

Results.ReviewText: Smaller grill for 2 customers.  We had a larger grill but the smaller for the grilled.
Results.Title: Propane grill

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill, great price ,great grilling area
Results.Title: Second Weber Q I've purchased in the last twenty-f

Results.ReviewText: Perfect travel grill for camping, great for burgers and dogs
Results.Title: Webber Q1200

Results.ReviewText: This grill cooks hotter than the previous (larger) Weber grill I had and I have to reduce the gas setting to about half instead of the hottest setting. The stand i had for the previous Weber grill also works with this smaller grill. I love it!
Results.Title: Love this grill
